Hero chart rises into the 1440x900 fold with the alert card (chart top y=640). Section headings stay Title Case by design (verbatim paper text), not scored down. Leftover: verdict text on the strategy cards is inconsistent (d-05-s3.png).

Hero 1-2-3 is clear. The band headline now sits level with the phone column, so the top right is no longer empty, and the statement now left-aligns at x=152 (d-01-statement.png). Still weak: in the pinned band a 300px black void sits between the 12:17 and 12:25 notes (d-15-BAND745.png, y 343-646).

Zodiak/Sentient plus mono for data, tight tracking, left-aligned body, 18px band paragraphs at 620px measure (d-13-BAND600.png), band headline wraps to two lines with a grey second tone and no orphan in EN. FR headline 'Votre telephone le 8 / octobre.' breaks after '8' (sections-fr/d-13-BAND600.png), minor.

Voids cut from 360-500px to about 300px on desktop (d-15-BAND745.png); mobile gap under the 12:17 note is still about 190px (m-14-BAND738.png). Strategy cards now share a stacked footer but the row-2 cards (md:col-span-3) leave a 70px hole above the verdict on card 4 (d-05-s3.png), and card 1 has a chip where cards 2-4 have plain text.

Identity holds at thumbnail size (sheet-d.png): newsprint, ink, rust, near-black band; semantic green/red only for meaning; light-mode shadows soft; --color-amber-night is now a token. Amber is still a small accent inside the band (note times, rail only).

Eight restyled 21st.dev pieces; code-review fixes (aria-pressed toggles, language links with aria-current, citation focus handling) improve function but no capture shows focus, hover or pressed, so these are not credited.

No gradients on text, glows, pills or uppercase labels. Remaining: the mono 'One-minute price, illustration' label (d-00-top.png) and mono band times keep a third voice; the phone body has a decorative radial amber/green gradient (Phone.tsx:75) that is barely visible.

Hero sequence plays in view; reduced-motion fold intact (desktop-fold-reduced.png); pinned scrubbed phone with live counters and different devices by section (sheet-d.png). Not credited: reduced-motion band, hover/pointer states.

390px (sheet-m.png): no horizontal scroll, hero and headline fit, docked phone with text under it, never empty. Deductions: 190px empty black under notes (m-14-BAND738.png) and the band headline wraps to 3 lines.

Both user-liked mechanisms read: Round's centred serif hero with the drawing rising (d-00-top.png), two-tone statement (d-01-statement.png), Auxia's cream-to-dark band with a two-tone headline (d-13-BAND600.png). Section treatments differ. The band peak is still diluted by the void between notes.
